id: title:dmarchuk:start a workflow from an issue

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a workflow initiation button and its implementation to the Error Tracking issue view, allowing users to start a workflow alongside the existing survey option.
review.reason: Adds an import and usage of IssueWorkflowButton in ErrorTrackingIssueScenePanel and its implementation, including workflow trigger configuration and click handler. This is a localized UI and workflow capability addition.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of the implementation and usage, but the actual benefit and user adoption are not demonstrated. No tier 2 or 3 evidence is present.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are used. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds an import for IssueWorkflowButton and its usage in the ErrorTrackingIssueScenePanel, alongside an existing CreateSurveyButton.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users viewing an error-tracking issue to start a workflow, while retaining the existing survey option.

observations.behavior: Defines IssueWorkflowButton component, its workflow trigger configuration, and the workflow URL, with a source attribution and a click handler.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the implementation for the workflow start action, including the workflow trigger and navigation, while preserving the click event's source attribution.
